chunks: From him, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muthannā al-Ḥannāṭ, from Abī Usāmah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: “Were it not that My believing servant would find something in his heart, I would surely bind the head of the disbeliever with a band of iron such that his head would never ache, ever.”

key_terms.بِعِصَابَةٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ: with a band of iron; a metaphor for preventing pain or affliction
key_terms.عَبْدِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُ: My believing servant; the faithful servant of Allah
key_terms.فِي قَلْبِهِ: in his heart; referring to an inward emotional or spiritual response
key_terms.لَا يُصَدَّعُ: it would not ache or be afflicted with pain

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah not grant disbelievers complete worldly ease according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys that Allah عَزَّ وَجَلَّ, in His wisdom, withholds complete worldly ease from the disbeliever for a higher purpose related to the inner state of the believer. It points to a divine management of worldly conditions that affects faith, perception, and spiritual trial.
